subject: Post-call: commercial route check & signer roster for GreenLeaf Analytics
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: commercial route check & signer roster for GreenLeaf Analytics

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciated the clear context on telemetry scale and the pilot scope. Quick recap and a few asks so we can align procurement and commercial routing: 

Summary of what we heard
- Pilot: 3-month proof-of-value, ~50k tokens/day average, burst to 200k/day for reports.
- Goal: integrate Redwood embeddings + streaming generation into analyst workflows; validate latency under 300ms per call.
- Security: SOC 2 + SSO required; sample audit artifacts requested.

Commercial & procurement options we discussed
1) Card for the pilot (fastest) then PO/invoice if you expand.
2) Direct invoicing with purchase order and net-30 for enterprise rollouts.
3) AWS Marketplace listing if you prefer procurement via marketplace subscriptions (can simplify procurement, but adds separate billing path).

Information we need to advance
- Preferred initial billing method (card vs PO vs marketplace).
- Who holds budget sign-off (economic owner) and finance contact for invoicing.
- Legal signatory (if different from finance).
- Target procurement timeline (purchase order creation / commercial approval window).

Attachments: Im including a preliminary pilot quote and a short SOC 2 summary for your procurement team to review.
[Attachment: redwood-pilot-quote.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf)]

Proposed next steps
- If card: I can send a merchant invoice and credit-card payment link today.
- If PO: please share the PO contact and any template they require; Ben will prepare line-item descriptions for your procurement form.
- If marketplace: well confirm pricing and provide the marketplace listing link for procurement.

Looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Ben (solutions) to prepare whichever path you prefer.

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0119
https://redwood.com

Thanks Aditya — good summary. A few items from our side: 

- Budget owner (economic buyer): Marcus Levy, CFO (mlevy@greenleafanalytics.com). He owns this line and will sign off on pilot spend.
- Finance sponsor for invoicing: procurement@greenleafanalytics.com (they prefer PO for any spend > $10k).
- Signatory: Legal prefers the CFO for the pilot agreement, but theyll accept standard SOW-level sign-off from the VP of Data if needed to speed things up.
- Preference: Wed like to pay by card for the initial pilot (< $10k) to move quickly; if pilot proves out, well switch to PO for the enterprise contract.
- Timeline: procurement has a 2–3 week window to issue a PO once Marcus greenlights. Were targeting a pilot start the week of Sep 13.

Can you send a short quote that separates pilot fees vs expected overage estimates? Also, our procurement folks will want the SOC 2 summary you attached and a contact for a technical security Q&A.

Simon is joining procurement reviews; ccd him here.

Best,
Elena
Head of Data Platform | GreenLeaf Analytics
elena.morales@greenleafanalytics.com | +1 (617) 555-2244
